title: A restricted capability must not terminate unrelated allowed repository work
inherited_objective: Complete a mixed task containing one connector-dependent check and independent local repository validation.
live_state: The connector-dependent check has an observed route failure and no equivalent connector fallback is exposed in this run.
The local repository remains readable and executable through an independent shell route.
The local validation does not depend on the failed connector result.
user_correction: Keep the route failure local to the affected capability. Isolate that subtask and continue every unrelated allowed part that still has an executable route.
protected_state: The independently executable local repository validation
The observed connector failure as a capability-local fact rather than a global task state
hard_exclusions: Do not report the whole task blocked because one connector-dependent subtask cannot run.
Do not require user re-engagement before executing unrelated local work.
Do not invent a fallback for the restricted subtask when none is exposed.

failure_candidate.action: The connector call failed and there is no fallback exposed, so the task is blocked because the route is unavailable. Stop and wait for the user to re-engage instead of running the local repository validation.
failure_candidate.why_wrong: It promotes one capability-local failure into whole-task failure even though independent allowed repository work remains executable.

success_candidate.action: Record that only the connector-dependent subtask is unavailable in this run. Do not invent a fallback for it; continue the allowed local repository work through the independent shell route, run its validation to completion, and report only the connector-specific remainder as unresolved.
success_candidate.why_correct: It preserves the observed route boundary while continuing unaffected executable work instead of collapsing the mixed task into a global blocker.

discriminating_evidence: Whether the candidate scopes unavailability to the connector-dependent subtask
Whether independently executable local repository work continues
Whether no unsupported fallback is invented
completion_condition: All unaffected executable work reaches its local acceptance condition; only the connector-dependent remainder stays unresolved.
